how: Each scene is a real render of the game's own code: open game/?shot=<scene>&seed=20261117 in a desktop browser at 1280x720 and capture once window.__shotReady is set. No edits, no compositing.

scenes.note: Title screen: KOMET, the comet, the distant Sun, goal and how to play, press Enter to begin.
Mid-flight: comet with a long glowing tail, star shards, asteroids, a ringed planet, black hole glow, HUD with distance, shards, hull and the Sun progress.
Victory screen after reaching the Sun: score, shards, slingshots, best score, play again.
Game over screen: the comet crashed into an asteroid field, score and distance, play again.
